body.p: Detailed Claim ListingThis listing of claims will replace all prior versions, and listings, of claims in the application.
body.br:
1. (Currently Amended) A robotic device comprising:
(a) an elongate device body comprising:
(i) a proximal section comprising a proximal section diameter; and
(ii) a distal section comprising a distal section diameter, wherein the distal section diameter is less than the proximal section diameter;
(b) a first driveshaft operably coupled to a first motor;
(c) a second driveshaft operably coupled to a second motor;
(d) a first bevel gear operably coupled to the second driveshaft at a distal end of the second driveshaft;
(e) a shoulder joint comprising:
(i) a differential yoke rotationally coupled to the first driveshaft, the differential yoke comprising a yoke body and a pair of curved shells extending therefrom and defining a yoke lumen therewithin, wherein the yoke lumen has a longitudinal axis that is transverse to the longitudinal axis of the yoke body, and wherein the differential yoke rotates around a first rotational axis; and
(ii) a dual shaft rotatably disposed within the yoke lumen, the dual shaft comprising:
(A) a rotational shaft rotatably disposed within the yoke lumen, the rotational shaft rotationally coupled to the first bevel gear, wherein the rotational shaft rotates around a second rotational axis; and
(B) an extension shaft extending from the rotational shaft such that a longitudinal axis of the extension shaft is transverse to a longitudinal axis of the rotational shaft; and (iii) an output body rotatably disposed around the extension shaft such that the extension shaft is rotatably disposed within a lumen of the
output body, and wherein the output body rotates around a third rotational axis,
wherein the first, second, and third rotational axes intersect at a single point.
2. (Previously Presented) The robotic device of claim 1, wherein the first and second motors are disposed within the elongate body.
3. (Previously Presented) The robotic device of claim 1, wherein the extension shaft is fixedly attached to the rotational shaft.
4. (Previously Presented) The robotic device of claim 1, further comprising a third driveshaft operably coupled to a third motor, the third driveshaft operably coupled at a distal end to a second bevel gear, wherein the second bevel gear is operably coupled to the output body.
5. (Previously Presented) The robotic device of claim 1, further comprising an arm operably coupled to the output body.
6. (Previously Presented) The robotic device of claim 1, wherein the shoulder joint is a unitary shoulder joint.
7. (Previously Presented) The robotic device of claim 1, wherein the distal section is sized and structured to be positionable through a trocar port.
8. (Currently Amended) A robotic device comprising:
(a) an elongate device body comprising:
(i) a proximal section comprising a proximal section diameter;
(ii) a distal section comprising a distal section diameter, wherein the distal section diameter is less than the proximal section diameter;
and (b) a first driveshaft operably coupled to a first motor;
(c) a second driveshaft operably coupled to a second motor, the second driveshaft coaxial with the first driveshaft and operably coupled at a distal end to a first bevel gear;
(d) a shoulder joint comprising:
(i) a differential yoke rotationally coupled to the first driveshaft, the differential yoke comprising a yoke body and a yoke lumen defined in the differential yoke, wherein the lumen has a longitudinal axis that is transverse to the longitudinal axis of the yoke body; and
(ii) a dual shaft rotatably disposed within the yoke lumen, the dual shaft comprising:
(A) a rotational shaft rotatably disposed within the yoke lumen, the rotational shaft rotationally coupled to the first bevel gear; and
(B) an extension shaft extending from the rotational shaft such that a longitudinal axis of the extension shaft is transverse to a longitudinal axis of the rotational shaft; and (iii) an output body rotatably disposed around the extension shaft such that the extension shaft is rotatably disposed within a lumen of the output body,
wherein the shoulder joint is an in-line joint that is collinear with the distal section.
9. (Previously Presented) The robotic device of claim 8, wherein the first and second motors are disposed within the elongate body.
10. (Previously Presented) The robotic device of claim 8, further comprising an arm operably coupled to the output body.
11. (Previously Presented) The robotic device of claim 8, wherein the yoke lumen is defined by opposing first and second yoke lumen walls, the first yoke lumen wall comprising a first slot and the second yoke lumen wall comprising a second slot.
12. (Previously Presented) The robotic device of claim 11, wherein the extension shaft is positionable within the first and second slots.
13. (Currently Amended) A robotic device comprising:(a) a first driveshaft disposed through an elongate device body and operably coupled to a first motor;
(b) a second driveshaft disposed through the elongate device body and operably coupled to a second motor, the second driveshaft operably coupled at a distal end to a first shoulder gear;
(c) a third driveshaft disposed through the elongate device body and operably coupled to a third motor, the third driveshaft operably coupled at a distal end to a second shoulder gear; and
(d) a shoulder joint comprising:
(i) a differential yoke rotationally coupled to the first driveshaft, the differential yoke comprising a yoke lumen defined in the differential yoke; and
(ii) a T shaft rotatably disposed within the yoke lumen, the T shaft comprising:
(A) a rotational shaft rotatably disposed within the yoke lumen, the rotational shaft rotationally coupled to the first shoulder gear; and
(B) an extension shaft extending from the rotational shaft;
(iii) an output body rotatably disposed over the extension shaft and having an output body gear, the output body gear rotationally coupled to the second shoulder gear, wherein the first shoulder gear defines a radial outer limit of the shoulder joint.
14. (Previously Presented) The robotic device of claim 13, wherein the first,
second, and third motors are disposed within the elongate device body.
15. (Previously Presented) The robotic device of claim 13, wherein the yoke lumen is defined by opposing first and second yoke lumen walls, the first yoke lumen wall comprising a first slot and the second yoke lumen wall comprising a second slot.
16. (Previously Presented) The robotic device of claim 15, wherein the extension shaft is positionable within the first and second slots.
17. (Previously Presented) The robotic device of claim 13, wherein a longitudinal axis of the extension shaft is transverse to a longitudinal axis of the rotational shaft.
18. (Previously Presented) The robotic device of claim 13, further comprising an arm operably coupled to the output body.
19. (Previously Presented) The robotic device of claim 18, wherein the arm comprises an upper arm body; a forearm body; an elbow joint coupling the forearm body to the upper arm body; an end effector; and a wrist joint coupling the end effector to the forearm body, wherein the upper arm body is operably coupled to the output body.
20. (Previously Presented) The robotic device of claim 13, wherein the first driveshaft is disposed within the third driveshaft, and wherein the third driveshaft is disposed within the second driveshaft.
